title: Endorsement
description: Generic endorsement ACDC used by the joint-issuance threshold operators (MxN, RMxN, MxQ, RMxQ). An endorsement asserts that its issuer (i) endorses the subject identified by 'said' for the act named in 'act'. A signed instance is an authenticated endorsement that counts toward a threshold. An unsigned instance is only a placeholder that reserves a slot for a named candidate endorser and does not count.

i.description: AID of the endorser. In an unsigned placeholder it names the candidate from whom an endorsement is expected; in a signed instance it is the authenticated endorser.

s.description: SAID of the schema applied to this ACDC.

a.description: Attributes block. Compact form: SAID string. Expanded form: object naming the endorsed subject and the act endorsed.

said.description: SAID of the subject being endorsed, typically the dossier ACDC whose joint issuance this endorsement contributes to.

act.description: The act being endorsed. 'issue' contributes to an MxN or MxQ issuance threshold; 'revoke' contributes to an RMxN or RMxQ revocation threshold. Binding the act prevents an issuance endorsement from being replayed as a revocation endorsement, or vice versa.
